description: Keyword plus meaning search over source-linked enterprise AI deployments. Use it for a topic in a few words, for example 'claims automation', 'AI agents in banking' or 'predictive maintenance'. For a whole company use get_company_profile; to narrow by industry, country, provider or case type use hybrid_search_usecases; to compare a use case you describe use find_similar_usecases. Each result has Url (the original public source), HubUrl (its page on aiusecasehub.com) and, where the company has one, CompanyPages (its hub company page). Pass a result's RowKey to get_usecase_details for the full record.

limit.description: Maximum results requested. Public previews return at most 3; personal-key access permits up to 20.

search_term.description: A topic in a few words, for example 'invoice processing' or 'AI agents in banking'.

name: search_usecases
title: Search enterprise AI deployments
